# Code derived from hierarchical_pruning

Some files in this crate are copied or ported from **hierarchical_pruning** by Parker
Carlson (<https://github.com/thefxperson/hierarchical_pruning>), commit
`fa0ede5241ea913ec9e293bdbef0d0b1012e7f07` (2026-07-20). That project is licensed under
the Apache License, Version 2.0; the full license text is in [`LICENSE`](LICENSE) in
this directory, copied unchanged from his repository. His repository has no NOTICE
file. Following section 4 of the license, every file below carries a notice saying
where it came from and that it was modified.

| file in this crate | derived from (in his repo) | what changed |
|---|---|---|
| `src/simdbp/kernels/sse3.rs` | `src/compress/simdbp_sse2.rs` (generated by his `scripts/generate_rust_sse2.py`) | copied by `scripts/vendor_simdbp_kernels.py`: only widths 0..=8 kept, dispatch tables and `#![rustfmt::skip]` removed, each function made `unsafe fn` with `#[target_feature(enable = "sse3")]`; function bodies unchanged |
| `src/simdbp/kernels/avx2.rs` | `src/compress/simdbp_avx2.rs` | same, `#[target_feature(enable = "avx2")]` |
| `src/simdbp/kernels/avx512.rs` | `src/compress/simdbp_avx512.rs` | same, `#[target_feature(enable = "avx512f,avx512bw")]` |
| `src/simdbp/kernel.rs` (`pack_scalar`, `unpack_scalar`) | `src/index/compress_simdbp.rs`, `pack_scalar` / `unpack_scalar` | rewritten to write into caller-provided slices instead of returning a `Vec`; width 0 handled explicitly; same bit layout |
| `src/simdbp/mod.rs` (the row format) | `src/index/compress_simdbp.rs`, `compress` and `Decompressor` | a new implementation of the same byte format (metablock headers + groups); differences: values > 255 are rejected, `n = 0` is allowed, no cached group, little-endian bytes instead of `Vec<u16>` |

The oracle in `tools/simdbp_oracle/` does not copy his code: it depends on his crate
(read-only, by path) to produce the golden vectors in `tests/data/simdbp/`, which are
output of his code. His repository is never modified.

To re-copy the kernels from a newer commit of his repo:

```sh
python3 scripts/vendor_simdbp_kernels.py ~/hierarchical_pruning src/simdbp/kernels
```

then update the commit hash above and in `src/simdbp/kernel.rs`, and regenerate the
golden vectors (`tools/simdbp_oracle/regenerate.sh`).
